convert_pdf_to_markdown: convert a PDF document to markdown text using marker-pdf OCR
convert_document_with_images: convert a document and extract embedded images to a specified output directory
convert_to_json_format: convert a document to structured JSON output with markdown and metadata fields
convert_with_llm_boost: convert a document using LLM-boosted accuracy for improved OCR results
check_disk_requirements: check available disk space before running marker-pdf extraction
